visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of small icon + label items: feature strips, product quick links, category tab navigation and cross-sell link lists

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: optional icon/image cell, then a cell with the label (often a link) and optional supporting text; an item with a single link is fully clickable

reuseGuidance: Default: centred icon over label. quick-nav for category tabs (current page highlighted); icon-beside-label for inline feature strips; alt for left-aligned icon + title + text; grid for fixed 4-up icon tiles; blue for a filled panel strip; card-cross-sell for a vertical list of card thumbnails linking to products.
